settings.exportIntro:
Form F.17.1 follows the RIGHTSHIP inspection & assessment report for dry cargo ships and where applicable OCIMF Ship Inspection Report (SIRE) Programme, Vessel Inspection Questionnaire (VIQ).
This form should be completed every 6 months, therefore there may be cases that is completed by 2 different superintendents, if time does not allow for 1 superintendent to complete.
The superintendent must respond to all the questions contained in each chapter. If an item is "Not Seen" or "Not Applicable" this should be stated.
A comment must be inserted when responding to any question with a "No". The comment must specify and explain the reason why a negative response is made. Observations must be recorded in the Observations List. Job Order List (F.17.2) should accompany form F.17.1 in which reference number (s/n) should also be mentioned. Where an additional comment of general information is appropriate, this may be recorded in the Additional Comments section at the end of each chapter. Additional comments are strongly encouraged to assist the understanding of the report recipient as to an issue associated with the specific question.
